fields.description: Program Description The university reviews the completeness and authenticity of applicants’ materials, and organizes eligible applicants to participate in the entrance examination (divided into interview and written examination). 1. Interview: It focused on assessing the applicant’s comprehensive quality and language communication ability. 2.Written examination: Exam Subjects: English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Mathematics. The university will conduct a comprehensive evaluation based on interview and written exam scores, and select the best candidates for admission. ★ Applicants can check the admission results on the international student service platform of Fujian Medical University, and the university will then send Admission Notice with the official seal of the university and the Visa Application Form for Foreign Students in China (JW202). ★After receiving the Admission Notice and Application Form for International Students to Study in China (JW202), applicants must bring the above materials, the original and photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Record , as well as their valid ordinary passport, to foreign visa agencies like the Chinese Embassy (Consulate General) to apply for a study visa (X1 visa) in China.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English Language Proficiency Certificate * 2. No criminal record certificate * 3. Scanned copy of the original Physical Examination Form for Foreigners The form must be the version uniformly issued by Chinese health and quarantine authorities and completed in Chinese or English. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Scanned copy of the information page of a valid passport * 5. Scanned copy of the Fujian Medical University Financial Guarantee Form for International Students And supporting financial documents, demonstrating personal funds, family support, government sponsorship, or financial sponsor backing. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. ID photo (2-inch bareheaded, front portrait against a blue background). * 7. Complete academic transcripts for the highest level of education attained (Chinese/English transcripts are acceptable; if in a language other than English, a notarized English translation is required) * 8. Highest academic qualification certificate If the applicant is currently enrolled as a student, a pre-graduation certificate or certificate of enrollment issued by the institution must be submitted. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Mathematics is a compulsory subject, and one elective must be chosen between Physics and Chemistry; taking the CSCA examination exempts candidates from the school's own entrance examination. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens aged 18 to 30, in good physical and mental health (without color blindness or color weakness), who have graduated from high school or possess an equivalent academic qualification. 2. Applicants who were born as foreign nationals with one or both parents being Chinese citizens residing abroad, as well as those who have emigrated from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan to a foreign country and are applying as international students, must hold a valid foreign passport or international documentation for at least four years (inclusive) and provide proof of having actually resided abroad for more than two years within the last four years (by April 30 of the enrollment year). 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: Non-native English speakers must provide proof of English proficiency through an IELTS Academic test (with an overall score no less than 6.0 and no individual band score below 5.0), TOEFL iBT (with an overall score no less than 70 and no individual section score below 15 ), or an equivalent standardized English test. Native English speakers or applicants who have completed their previous education entirely in English are exempt from submitting English test scores but must provide official documentation from their previous institution certifying their English performance and confirming that the medium of instruction was English. 4. The previous academic performance shall meet one of the following requirements: (1) Excellent performance in senior high school graduation examinations, with the score of mathematics no less than 70 points (out of 100 points), and the score of either physics or chemistry also no less than 70 points (out of 100 points). (2) Having completed the Preparatory program recognized by our university and met the graduation standards. 5. A score not lower than 70 points (on a 100-point scale) in the entrance interview (conducted remotely or on campus). 6. CSCA score report: Mathematics is a compulsory subject; either Physics or Chemistry may be chosen as an additional subject.
